svg.title: How water moves through it

text.tspan: Two filter stages in series, sealed by two O-rings above and below the disc cassette. Those O-rings are the only barrier between dirty and clean
Bottle water passes outside-in through the 20 µm cup. Sand, fibres and plastic over
20 µm stay in the bottle side.
It spreads under 8 roof ribs across the full 38.5 mm disc face.
The sintered 316L disc catches particles on its top face. The cake that forms there is what
Filtered water runs between 8 drain ribs to a Ø2 port in the stem and out through the
When you let go, the silicone umbrella valve opens at 0.03 bar and the bottle springs
back. The wet disc cannot pass air: it needs 2.9 bar.
Not yet in the v2 drawings or BOM:
the air-return valve and the silicone grip ring. Both are
shown here and used in the simulation.
